title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 01/2012
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Warm matrix recording with deep drum presence captures a patient, inspiring second set that really shines.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its inspired, patient second set—especially the memorable Earthquake Space—and overall high energy. The behind‑stage/matrix source adds depth to the drums and a pleasant reverb that softens the thin vocal tone, resulting in a good but not pristine sound. Listeners consistently recommend it despite minor tonal quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on the musical performance (especially the second set) and generally good recording quality, with only mild technical reservations.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Behind‑stage/matrix capture gives extra snare depth and less crowd noise; reverb adds warmth but vocals can sound thin/tinny. Board quality described as not great, but overall pleasant listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set praised for its patience and inspiration; the band takes their time yet maintains strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Drums: Snare depth noted as richer than typical audience mixes; drums sound fuller from the behind‑stage mic.
